description:
Get a token's holder snapshot

How concentrated a token's holders are: the total holder count, the share of supply held by the top 10/50/100/200 wallets and how many wallets hold half the supply. Refreshed about daily from a market-data vendor; `fetchedAt` says when. It lists no wallet addresses. Counts of flagged wallets (snipers, bundlers, insiders) are unavailable, so `quality` is empty. For a coin launched on Chain Daddy, `openBlock` says who bought in its opening blocks ("bundled at open"); it is absent when those blocks were not seen.

A token page id is unique per chain, not across chains; `symbol` and `chainId` in the answer say which token it describes. `404` means no token page, or no snapshot yet.

id.description: The token page's id (the registration's numeric token id)

name: get_token_holder_snapshot

breakdown.description:
How the figures were reached: the source, the share of supply left out (pool reserves, burn)
and named balances (team, fee address). Labels and percentages only, no addresses.

top10Pct.description: Percent of supply (0-100) held by the top 10 wallets

walletsForHalf.description: How many of the largest wallets together hold half the supply

openBlock.description: "Bundled at open": who bought in the coin's opening blocks (EVM: the launch block and the next 3; Solana: the first 30 slots). Absent when the opening blocks were not seen.

bundledPct.description: Percent of supply bought in the opening blocks by wallets buying 3 or more to a block

bundledWallets.description: How many wallets bought in those blocks

buyers.description: Wallets that bought in the opening blocks

creatorLinkedPct.description: Percent of supply bought in the opening blocks by wallets linked to the creator (wallets the creator controls, or funded by the creator or the creator's funder)

linkedPending.description: Links between the buyers and the creator are still being read

linkedWallets.description: How many opening buyers are linked to the creator

quality.description: Flagged-wallet counts, each present only when measured. Unavailable today, so empty.

title: Get a token's holder snapshot
